verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms a downloadable OpenAPI document at developers.cloudflare.com/openapi.json: it returns HTTP 200 and contains an "openapi" key. That directly satisfies the core of the story. missing for 10: first-party documentation describing the spec and how to download it, explicit confirmation that it covers the Workers API endpoints, versioning/update details, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
